column1: # Dataset Top-20 2026 — what the AGENT-117/118/119/120 bench matrix pulls (20 images).
# Rows and their order come from performance/input/filter.tsv: ChimangoScanTop150 sorted by
# loaded_rank (pull_count * size_bytes), ranks 1-20, linux/amd64; a rank with no amd64 manifest
# is dropped and backfilled from the next one (15, 16, 20 out; 21-23 in).
# size_bytes / resolved_at / amd64_digest: Docker Hub as scanned at resolved_at.
# mirror_repository / mirror_digest: what cr.selcloud.ru served at capture time — mirroring
# re-wraps the manifest, so mirror_digest is not comparable to amd64_digest.
